facts.fact: Cinnamon 把深夜跟车按喇叭的跟踪者认成邻居 Bran。
facts.anchor: Why was Bran in such a rush to get back to the apartment complex? And whose car was he borrowing? He almost made me cause a wreck honking behind me.

facts.fact: 她说 Bran 车技差、见到她总要跟回家——所以这只是她的猜测。
facts.anchor: At least, I assumed it was him, he was always a terrible driver and loved to follow me home if he saw me out.

facts.fact: 断鼻和双膝开裂比起她历来的事故不算什么，但依然疼。
facts.anchor: Honestly, a broken nose and two split knees are nothing compared to some of the other accidents I have incurred, but they still sting.

facts.fact: Sherry 的判词在她脑内回放：宇宙用受伤提示你走错了路。
facts.anchor: It’s just the universe’s way of showing you you’re on the wrong path.

facts.fact: 凌晨四点她点开邮箱，几十封邮件让她看呆。
原因是她自己踩掉了插线板上的电源线。
facts.anchor: I have managed to step on the cord and detach it from the overfilled power strip.

facts.fact: 变压器被烧断——她加了句 Again，这类事故已是重演。
facts.anchor: A transformer must have blown. Again.

facts.fact: 她抱起青蛙，不敢深想跟了自己多年的坏运气。
facts.anchor: I gather the frog in my arms and try not to think too closely about all of my bad luck. On how it has followed me for years.

facts.fact: 她把注意力转回兴奋：有人想雇她当厨师了。
facts.anchor: I have emails! People want me to be their chef!
